 Peter Thomas Roth Expands into RCS Marketing with Listrak
 Marketers can send creatively dynamic messages featuring carousels, high-resolution images, videos and interactive buttons while enabling quick replies and in-message engagement. 
 November 15, 2026 
 By: Lianna Albrizio 
 Associate Editor , Happi 
 Save 
 Image caption -->
 Peter Thomas Roth has collaborated with its e-commerce marketing partner, the cross-channel personalization platform Listrak , to implement Rich Communication Services (RCS) messaging, delivering branded, interactive mobile messaging to RCS-enabled devices.
 Since 2024, Peter Thomas Roth has partnered with Listrak to grow its ecommerce business and personalize customer communications. The addition of RCS builds upon the retailer’s mobile messaging program, delivering higher conversion rates and revenue per send than SMS.
 “Listrak was the first marketing platform provider to launch an RCS campaign in the US, and we are now at the inflection point where it is becoming imperative for brands who want to build relationships with their customers to adopt RCS,” said Ross Kramer, cofounder and CEO, Listrak. “The team at Peter Thomas Roth is at the forefront, leveraging the latest innovations to connect with consumers in meaningful ways.”
 RCS brings the features of messaging apps into the native texting app on a shopper’s phone. Android phones have supported RCS for years, and Apple added support with iOS 18 in September 2024, opening the channel to brands messaging both iPhone and Android users. Listrak was reportedly the first marketing platform provider to launch an RCS marketing campaign in the US, during the 2024 holiday season. With RCS, marketers can send creatively dynamic messages featuring carousels, high-resolution images, videos, and interactive buttons, while enabling quick replies and in-message engagement, and enhancing trust with verified sender information and brand styling.
 Peter Thomas Roth ‘s recent RCS campaigns included promotions supporting several of the brand’s key fall shopping moments, including early access to sitewide sales, free gift-with-purchase offers, loyalty rewards messaging and more.
